Line trace: speed when both sensors are on the line.
Line trace: outer wheel when correcting.
Line trace: inner wheel when correcting / creeping to find the line.

ROUTE: how many blocks the next across / stop / acrossTrace move counts. Stays set until changed.
ROUTE: speed for goForward / goBackward (0-255).
ROUTE: time for goForward / goBackward in ms (1000 = 1 s).
ROUTE: line-trace time in 1/100 s (810 = 8.1 s). Used by lineTrace and acrossTrace.
acrossTrace: straight drive after the last block before line tracing starts, in ms (500 = 0.5 s).
Speed of the straight move after an across (and before line tracing).
Time of the straight move after an across, in ms (600 = 0.6 s). Longer = turn later.
Block sensor: reading BELOW this = white block. Same value as the built-in Across block (125).
Speed while counting blocks.
Speed on the LAST block (slower = more accurate stop / turn point).
Straight: a wheel that would go slower than this is switched off instead (too slow = stalls and whines/beeps).
Fastest a wheel may go (255 = motor max).
Straight: steering strength per degree off (x10, 50 = 5.0). Raise if it drifts.
Straight: damping (x10). Lower if it weaves left-right.
Straight: learns the left/right motor difference. Raise if it still curves, lower if it weaves after a few moves.
Limit for the learned motor correction (keeps it from running away).
Brake: reverse pulse speed when stopping.
Brake: reverse pulse time in ms.
Anti double-count: sensor must go above thresh + hyst (black) before the next block can count.
Turn accuracy in tenths of a degree (10 = 1 deg).
Turn is done only after staying inside turnTol10 this long (1/100 s, 20 = 0.2 s).
Last part of a turn (tenths of a degree, 150 = 15 deg) done at turnMinSpd for precision.
Full stop before every turn, in ms (150 = 0.15 s).
Right turns always off? Extra tenths of a degree (20 = 2 deg more, -20 = 2 deg less).
Left turns always off? Extra tenths of a degree (20 = 2 deg more, -20 = 2 deg less).
Turn speed per degree still to go (x10).
Slowest turning speed (start of the creep at the end of a turn).
Fastest turning speed.
Stall kick: if a turn stops moving, add this much power every 0.05 s until it moves (no stall whine).
Line trace: forward speed when both sensors lost the line and no side is known (V4 had 30 = stall whine).
Safety: give up on a turn after this long (1/100 s, 350 = 3.5 s).

scripts.comment: HOW TO USE 1. Only edit the MAIN script (this one, under the green flag). 2. Build the route below 'ROUTE STARTS HERE' with 'broadcast and wait' blocks. Copy them from the FLOATING BLOCKS column (right-click > duplicate) and snap them in. 3. Moves that need a number read a variable: nBlocks (across / stop moves), moveSpd + moveMs (goForward / goBackward), traceCs (lineTrace). A variable keeps its value, so only set it when it changes. 4. Normal 'wait' blocks work as usual. 5. To upload: right-click this script > the Arduino export / upload option. DON'T: put a broadcast inside one of the move scripts on the right, rename them, or edit them unless you are tuning.

scripts.comment: FLOATING BLOCKS (not connected = they don't run). Right-click a stack > duplicate, then drop it into the main script route. Change the number in the 'set' block.
MOVE SCRIPT (don't edit): R90: perfect gyro right 90.
MOVE SCRIPT (don't edit): L90: perfect gyro left 90.
MOVE SCRIPT (don't edit): U180: perfect gyro 180 (turns right).
MOVE SCRIPT (don't edit): across: set nBlocks first. Straight across nBlocks blocks, then overSpd for overMs (= your 'move 160, wait 0.5'), then stop.
MOVE SCRIPT (don't edit): acrossTrace: set nBlocks first. Across nBlocks, straight overSpd for preTraceMs (no stop), then line tracing for traceCs, stop, re-lock heading.
MOVE SCRIPT (don't edit): acrossR90: set nBlocks first. Across nBlocks -> 160 for 0.5 s -> perfect right 90.
MOVE SCRIPT (don't edit): acrossL90: set nBlocks first. Across nBlocks -> 160 for 0.5 s -> perfect left 90.
MOVE SCRIPT (don't edit): stopR90: set nBlocks first. Across nBlocks, stop ON the last block -> perfect right 90.
MOVE SCRIPT (don't edit): stopL90: set nBlocks first. Across nBlocks, stop ON the last block -> perfect left 90.
MOVE SCRIPT (don't edit): goForward: straight at moveSpd for moveMs (ms), then stop.
MOVE SCRIPT (don't edit): goBackward: straight backward at moveSpd for moveMs (ms), then stop.
MOVE SCRIPT (don't edit): lineTrace: find the line (3 s max), trace for traceCs (1/100 s, 800 = 8 s), stop, then re-lock heading to the grid.
MOVE SCRIPTS - the engine. Each one is called by its name from the main route. Leave them alone unless tuning.
